FROM-ZERO UI CONCEPT B — EMERGENCY BROADCAST. Ignore the current Onslaught visual design and create a fresh interface from first principles while preserving gameplay hooks, required DOM IDs, and the existing mobile input architecture. Direction: abandoned civil-defense control room / emergency broadcast system during a zombie outbreak. Think blackened concrete, faded paper/ivory text, hazard orange, emergency red, numbered sectors, warning stripes used sparingly, mono/condensed typography, analog status labels, siren-language urgency. Avoid cyan, cyberpunk neon, futuristic glass, rounded app cards, or conventional HUD chrome. Redesign the start/redeploy screen, combat telemetry, health, ammo/weapon readout, crosshair, damage state, and touch controls so they feel like one emergency-survival system. Keep the center clear, prioritize glance readability, and make phone landscape/safe areas excellent. CSS may be replaced wholesale; change source main.js/mobile-source-bridge markup/styles where useful without altering game mechanics. Avoid expensive full-screen filters/animations. Return a substantial implementation-ready unified diff, not an audit-only response. Do not claim tests were run.
